packageRules.description: Disable updates to 3rd party GitHub action to reduce security risk
Keeps .nvmrc and package.json's engines.node in a single PR so they cannot drift apart
prBodyNotes:
## Notice for developers

`package.json`'s `engines.node` is what the `heroku/nodejs` buildpack reads to pick the Node.js distribution baked into the deployed image — the buildpack ignores `.nvmrc` entirely. Both must move together: `engines.node` is what fixes production, `.nvmrc` keeps CI and local dev aligned with it.

Node patch bumps also carry the bundled npm, and npm vendors its own copy of `tar`. Several `tar` CVEs are only resolvable by moving Node, so please don't defer these.
